comparison.interpretation: P2-D B's stochastic training episode outcomes differ from deterministic full-episode evaluation; do not treat them as contradictory or interchangeable. Evaluation is deterministic actor means, training collection is stochastic SAC action sampling.

limitations: Only full replay at 10k is stored; 2k and 5k are deterministic 1024-transition replay samples, not complete buffers.
Critic Q and local action derivatives are learned estimates, not ground truth.
kNN action support is a descriptive heuristic, not a formal support estimator.
Observed action consequences are confounded by state, policy, geometry and episode selection; no causal long-horizon Q conclusion is made.
scope: offline TRAIN-only analysis of frozen P2-D checkpoints/replay; no training or evaluation rollout
